heading: none
name: 窄文字欄＋出血橫式大圖圖文並排
desc: 文字欄約三成、橫式主圖約七成的單組圖文並排；主圖貼齊區塊上緣與畫面側緣，文字欄以分隔線隔開標題與說明，左右可對調。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。單組圖文左右並排：文字欄約佔三成，主圖約佔七成；主圖是橫式，貼齊區塊上緣與畫面右緣，區塊上方不留白；主圖明顯是區塊裡最大的元素，右下角可放一個小圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。文字欄靠左對齊、相對主圖垂直置中，由大標題（可多行）、一條分隔線、說明文字由上而下排列，下方可放文字連結，沒有時省略。左右可對調：主圖在左、貼齊畫面左緣，文字欄在右。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大標題、分隔線與說明文字在上，橫跨內容寬度，大標題貼齊區塊上緣、區塊上方不留白；主圖在下，改為直式並橫跨畫面寬。左右對調的版本在手機上同樣是文字在上、主圖在下。

en.name: Narrow text column with a bleeding landscape image
en.desc: A single media-and-text pair with a text column of about three tenths and a landscape main image of about seven tenths; the image is flush with the top of the section and the side of the viewport, a divider separates the headline from the description, and the sides may be swapped.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A single pair of text and image sits side by side: the text column takes about three tenths of the width and the main image about seven tenths. The main image is landscape and is flush with the top edge of the section and the right edge of the viewport, with no spacing above the section; it is clearly the largest element in the section, and optionally a small icon button sits in its bottom-right corner; omit it when there is no content. The text column is aligned left and vertically centered relative to the main image, stacking from top to bottom a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), a divider, and a description; optionally place a text link below; omit it when there is no content. The sides may be swapped: main image on the left, flush with the left edge of the viewport, and text column on the right.
en.mobile: Changes to a vertical stack: the headline, divider and description on top, spanning the content width, with the headline flush with the top edge of the section and no spacing above the section; the main image below, changed to portrait and spanning the viewport width. The swapped version also places the text on top and the main image below on mobile.

extras.name: 捲到時主圖由上往下揭開、標題上移
extras.prompt: 捲動到這個區塊時播放一次進場動畫，不固定、不跟著捲動進度播放：主圖從上往下逐漸揭開，同時由下往上移入定位；大標題由下往上移入。動畫在捲動停下後仍會播完。
extras.mobile: 手機保留同樣的進場效果。

en.name: Main image reveals top-down and headline rises on scroll
en.prompt: When the section is scrolled into view, play an entrance animation once, without pinning and without following scroll progress: the main image is gradually revealed from top to bottom while moving up into place, and the headline moves up into place. The animation finishes playing even after scrolling stops.
en.mobile: Mobile keeps the same entrance effect.
